summary: Change set stays within contract: local-only Stitch assets (14 JPEGs under public/, no remote URLs), typed mock data with backward-compatible aliases (initialRecords/initialMoments), additive optional type fields, semantic token additions, and route-aware chrome that hides the parent BottomNav on /login, /register, /onboarding while preserving the accessible fixed nav (aria-label, pb-safe) on product routes. Root route correctly uses useRouterState so the shell reacts to navigation; AppShell has an SSR-safe window fallback. Evidence shows focused tests (7 passing) and typecheck/build green. No secrets, no PII (all baby data is clearly fictional with 2026 mock dates), no auth logic weakened (chrome-only change), no new dependencies. Only low-severity nits: duplicated brand alt text for screen readers, a height/weight inconsistency in the mock baby profile vs. growth records, exact-match auth path detection, and a global overscroll behavior change. Safe to merge.
